headline: Bitcoin Slides Toward $77,000 Following Binance Hack and Nasdaq Sell-Off
summary: Bitcoin declined to $77,192 on Friday, its lowest close in a month, driven by a record $6.3 billion theft from crypto exchange Binance and a broader sell-off on the Nasdaq.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization and serves as a primary benchmark for digital asset sentiment.
